pkgmetadata.longdescription: OpenAI Codex, the command-line coding agent, packaged from the official prebuilt musl archive rather than installed with the vendor install.sh. The payload is self-contained (its own rg, bwrap, zsh and gstreamer runtime) and Portage owns the files under /usr/opt/codex, so upgrades are transactional and the package can be removed cleanly. Entries here supersede the older hand-maintained dev-util/codex-bin ebuilds that lived in the untracked sloom-private overlay.
